summary: Implementation plan for integrating the Python tvdatafeed pipeline for PEPPERSTONE:SPOTBRENT (up to 5,000 candles across M15, H1, H4, D1), storing in the cPanel host MariaDB database, setting TradingView (PEPPERSTONE) as the default provider for SPOTBRENT, and expanding history/slider limits to 5,000 candles on Web and Android.
